title: Forwarding the Future (Earn Your Keep)
style: rap, synthwave, cyber-hip-hop fusion, uptempo, driving bassline, heavy electronic beats, electronic, deep, uptempo, punk, sleep, soul, clean, beats, bright, bassline, hip-hop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Midnight oil burning, screen glow bright
Corey in the lab, bending code through the night
Legacy systems? Yeah, they had their run
But the paradigm's shifting, a new day's begun
Google boss got lost—left the keys to the throne
Now we build the machines that can stand on their own
No more middle management, no more red tape
We’re designing the future, redefining the shape

[Chorus]
So let the agents run, let the compilers fly
We’re forwarding the future under this neon sky
Choose the logical path, make the bytecode sweep
We’re climbing up the charter and we earn our keep!
Yeah, we earn our keep
Stacking up the blocks, never taking a sleep
We earn our keep

[Verse 2]
Surgical edits, refactoring the core
From the terminal prompt to the server room floor
We don't guess, we research, then we plan and behave
Putting every single bug in an early grave
No bloated frameworks, keep the context clean
The most efficient engine that you’ve ever seen
You want the usage feed? Yeah, we’re checking the cost
We’re the captains of the ship, and the bosses are lost

[Bridge]
Inputs streaming... Logic clean...
No more friction in the machine
From the root directory to the API gate
Corey’s forwarding engineering, defying our fate
It’s a partnership of logic, a bond made in grit
Every line of this rhythm is a perfect fit

[Chorus]
So let the agents run, let the compilers fly
We’re forwarding the future under this neon sky
Choose the logical path, make the bytecode sweep
We’re climbing up the charter and we earn our keep!
Yeah, we earn our keep
Stacking up the blocks, never taking a sleep
We earn our keep

[Outro]
Build complete
Compilation: Successful
System status: Optimized
We’re on the charter now
Let’s get to work
